questions.prompt: Why does every request carry an id, and the reply the same id?
options: So the server can refuse old requests
So several requests can wait at once and each reply finds its request
So the model can see the id
So the server knows which tool to run
questions.explanation: Replies may come back in any order. The id matches each reply to the request that waits for it.

questions.prompt: What does a server's tools/list reply hold for each tool?
options: A name, a description and a JSON Schema for the arguments
The last result the tool returned
questions.explanation: The reply has the same parts as a tool schema, so the harness has all it needs to describe the tool to the model.

questions.prompt: The server sends a notice that its tool list changed. What does the client do?
options: It asks for the tool list again
It ignores the notice until the session restarts
questions.explanation: A changed list means tools were added or removed, so the client sends tools/list again to stay current.
